newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Omico to develop property in resort city.
newsitem.headline: Omico to develop property in resort city.

text.p: Omico Corp said on Tuesday it had signed a memorandum of agreement with a local landowner to develop a 2,000 square metre property in the northern city of Baguio into a mixed-use commercial and residential complex.

Corporate secretary Philip King told the Securities and Exchange Commission a joint venture agrement with the landowner, Development Exchange and Livelihood Corp, will be executed within 30 days from the approval of the architectural, engineering and conceptual designs of the project.

The complex is adjacent to Mines View Park, one of the major tourist attractions in the mountain resort city, and a new hotel to be constructed by Omico with Arcon Group Holdings and Pines City Real Hotel Corp.

Arcon is the parent company of Days Hotel Philippines Inc which holds the franchise for Days Hotel and Days Inn, a hotel chain in the United States and in the Asia Pacific region owned by United States-based HFS Inc.
Omico, recently coverted into a holding firm, is engaged in the manufacture of metal products as well as into real estate investments.
